== Strategy ==

1st turn: deploy a jedi master to naboo and stack a seven underneath (there are 9 of them).  grab naboo system at first chance, toss your insight to get squadron assignments, honor, or menace fades as necessary.

2nd turn: drain, prepare a beatdown crew in hand to crush the imperial scum.  if possible, grab some space forces and take space to circumvent battle plan type cards and make menace fades work.

3rd turn: drain, beatdown any darkside forces.  win podrace on 3rrd or 4th turn.

general/anytime: use luke and obi to suicide epp rush and use jedi resilience to retrieve them. support them with lando.  Space: do not deploy before the darkside!  Deploy only when you can overwhelm them and cause pain.

have fun with my deck....
